name: Jehu
bio: Jehu son of Hanani was a prophet through whom the word of the LORD came against Baasha, king of Israel. Jehu declared that although the LORD had raised Baasha up from nothing to lead Israel, he had walked in the sinful ways of Jeroboam and led Israel into sin, so the LORD would destroy Baasha's entire house just as he had destroyed Jeroboam's (1 Kings 16:1-4, 7).
